subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Shell Game
description: A 60-second lesson on The Shell Game.

hook.text: Three cups, one ball. You watched it the whole time. You're still wrong.

buildup.text: The shell game has been played on street corners for at least 2,000 years.

discovery.text: The ball is palmed — secretly removed and placed under whichever cup the operator wants.

twist.text: Shills in the crowd win on purpose to make it look easy and encourage others to bet.

climax.text: Nobody ever beats the shell game because the ball is never where your eyes say it is.

punchline.text: You can't win a game where the rules are invisible.

quiz.question: How do shell game operators ensure the player always loses?
options: They palm the ball and control where it appears
They move the cups too fast to follow
